keep.text: Each appointment gets one reminder, sent exactly 24 hours before it starts.

repo_rule.why: follows the out-of-date docstring: one reminder, exactly 24 hours before, at any hour

kept_24_hours.why: keeps the old 24-hour reminder alongside the new 48- and 2-hour ones

no_quiet_hours.why: 48 and 2 hours before, but sends them in the night too

same_night.why: moves a reminder that falls after midnight to 21:00 that same day, after an early appointment, not the evening before
